Kalshi demo · external-api.demo.kalshi.co

Five-topic market dashboard, with the ≥ $0.10 swing detector running on your own browser

This page reads the public Kalshi demo REST API directly from your browser — no key, no proxy, no server of ours. It watches gas prices, elections, culture, crypto and golf, posts every $0.10-or-larger price swing into two scrolling feeds (all events / high-ROI only), and shows the full order-book ladder so you can see how many contracts are actually available at each price.

Two alert feeds

Both are driven by the same detector: consecutive sweeps of the same market, absolute move ≥ $0.10. The right feed is the same stream filtered by a published score — it is a ranking aid, not a forecast. Nothing is back-filled: if a sweep shows no move, no message appears.

What "live" means here. The dashboard's numbers come from Kalshi's demo exchange (external-api.demo.kalshi.co), which Kalshi documents as using mock funds and whose prices may diverge from production. If your browser cannot reach the API — or Kalshi does not send CORS headers for this origin — the page switches to the committed snapshot and labels every number with its capture time. Trading is simulated: this project holds no API key and sends no orders.
